name: nexplay
description: NexPlay — plateforme mondiale de jeux compétitifs

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexplay/game-core && npm run build -w @nexplay/game-ludo && npm run build -w @nexplay/game-dames && npm run build -w @nexplay/api && npm run build -w @nexplay/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nexplay/game-core && npm run build -w @nexplay/game-ludo && npm run build -w @nexplay/game-dames && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @nexplay/api" "npm run dev -w @nexplay/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @nexplay/game-core && npm run build -w @nexplay/game-ludo && npm run build -w @nexplay/game-dames && npm run dev -w @nexplay/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nexplay/game-ludo && npm run test -w @nexplay/game-dames && npm run test -w @nexplay/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @nexplay/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @nexplay/web --if-present
